resolved_conflicts.explanation: Record structure says 1871; Lighthouse Friends and Parks Canada say 1870, first lit 7 Nov 1870.

notes_for_editor: Thin station: no Department annual reports before 1900 in corpus. Keeper surname spelled Arseneau (LF) vs Arsenault (Register). Dept 1904-05 table lists James Arseneau at Dalhousie Harbour appointed 18 Jan 1894; LF says Joseph appointed 1894; matched by date only, station name in table not confirmed as Inch Arran. Joseph's 1888 start is approximate. Parks Canada statement says family kept light to 1935; LF's last dated item is 1929. Backgrounder dated Feb 2017; the record's 2016 designation date is unverified. Rear light history not found. Sentence 'Settlers ... are said to have named' is LF's account. Story mixes Heritage Lighthouse designation 2017 cite [2][3]: LF cited via Rowlett in no source; LF page text read for 1991 only; 2017 rests on cite 3 (Canada.ca backgrounder). Fact-check 2026-10-27: removed unsourced 1871 date remark (record value, no citable source); noted LF keeper list gives James Arseneau 1894-1913 vs its text Joseph; dept table name matched to station by position only (Dalhousie Harbour, same line).
